text.what: Australia's coldest vineyards, split between the Tamar in the north and the Coal River and Derwent in the south. Most of the pinot noir goes into sparkling base; the rest is picked ripe enough to bottle red.

kin.as: Grown for bubbles first, red second.
The model the sparkling program copies, at 42°S.
